text: ありがと…　マヨ　きのみを　とりに　きてたんだよ　これ　あげる！

structure.jp: マヨ　きのみを　とりに　きてたんだよ
structure.en: Lostelle had come to pick Berries

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before 'come' or 'go' tells what you come or go to do. とりに　きてた = 'had come to pick them'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after 'come' means having come and being here; てた is the casual short past form. きてた = 'had come here'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end shows the speaker is explaining the situation. きてたんだ = 'I had come here, you see'.
